description: Advanced CIRCulation (ADCIRC) is a model or estimator listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by USACE, U.S. Army Corps of Engineers; Coastal Hydraulics Laboratory; Naval Research Laboratory. ADCIRC is a system of computer programs for solving time dependent, free surface circulation and transport problems in two and three dimensions. These programs utilize the finite element method in space allowing the use of highly flexible, unstructured grids. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Flooding – Coastal. Assets: Critical Facilities, Transportation and Mobility, Water Infrastructure – Stormwater. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
